content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the logging function using the previous timestamp (the time the node was last seen) instead of the current timestamp when logging messages. This issue was introduced in a previous commit (d377756f) and resulted in incorrect timestamps being logged, leading to confusion about the actual time of events. The patch fixes this by ensuring that the current timestamp is passed to the logging function, thus providing accurate timestamps in the log output. Additionally, the patch separates the console output from the log output, preventing additional timestamps from cluttering the log text.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: -	sprintf(msg, FMT_PREFIX "Station attempting %s with AP %s at: %s",
-	sprintf(msg, FMT_PREFIX "AP sent %s to station %s at: %s",
-	sprintf(msg, FMT_PREFIX "%s probing for SSID '%s' at: %s",
